units.text: EXT. GLASS FOREST - DAWN
Trees of translucent crystal rise in endless columns, trunks like frozen waterfalls.
Light bends through them, scattering rainbows across a floor of powdered quartz.
The air chimes.
KESTREL AYODELE-VANCE (20s, scout's leathers, a bow slung across her back) steps through the trunks, careful of each footfall.
BARROW (50s, dwarf, bearded, hammer at his belt) trundles behind her.
THE LADY IMOGEN (ageless, pale cloak, sword of white metal) walks last, one hand tracing the trees.
And between them, trotting at Kestrel's heels, a small fox-faced creature named PIP (appears to be a child of seven, ears slightly too pointed).
Is it true the trees sing?
units.name: PIP

units.text: Only when they're angry.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: Which is always.
units.name: BARROW

units.text: A deep thrum shakes the forest.
Crystals tremble.
Pip clutches Kestrel's hand.
Imogen halts and raises her blade.
Kestrel nocks an arrow; Barrow swings the hammer from his belt; they form a rough triangle around the child, backs to the trunks.
Stay close. Do not look at your reflection.
units.name: THE LADY IMOGEN

units.text: Easy for her to say. She hasn't got one.
units.name: BARROW

units.text: The thrum rises to a chord.
From between the trees, a shape, tall, many-limbed, assembled from shards, glides forward.
It tilts.
Its glittering face turns toward Pip.
Barrow, left!
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: Barrow charges.
The creature swats him aside; he tumbles into a trunk, which rings like a bell.
Kestrel looses an arrow.
It shatters on the creature's chest.
Imogen lunges and her blade sinks to the hilt.
The creature shrieks, a sound like glass breaking underwater.
It lashes out and sweeps Imogen off her feet, then Kestrel, then Barrow, who has staggered back into the fight.
Stop!
units.name: PIP

units.text: Everything freezes.
Kestrel on her back.
Barrow half-risen.
Imogen with her sword pinned.
The creature, towering, turns to the child.
Pip steps forward.
He holds out both hands.
I know your song.
units.name: PIP

units.text: He hums three notes.
The creature sways.
Its shards soften from white to gold.
It kneels, slowly, until its face is level with the boy's.
Pip.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: It's all right. It's only lonely.
units.name: PIP

units.text: Imogen lowers the blade.
Barrow lowers the hammer.
The creature reaches out one shard-fingered hand and touches Pip's forehead, and a single rainbow bursts through the canopy and floods the clearing in color.
Of course.
units.name: THE LADY IMOGEN

units.text: Always the small ones.
units.name: BARROW

units.text: The forest begins, very softly, to sing.
